channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Adobe
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Adobe, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch now: Adobe Commerce and Magento: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
item.description:
Adobe Commerce and Magento: Arbitrary file upload · pre-auth · remote · user interaction · exploited · fix: 2.4.9-2026-jul, 2.4.8-2026-jul, 2.4.7-2026-jul

First step: Update Adobe Commerce and Magento to the fixed version for your release line (for example 2.4.9-2026-jul, 2.4.8-2026-jul or 2.4.7-2026-jul).

Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-48356

item.title: Keep patched: Adobe Commerce and Magento: Incorrect Authorization
item.description:
Adobe Commerce and Magento: Broken access control · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 2.4.9-2026-aug, 2.4.8-2026-aug, 2.4.7-2026-aug

First step: Update Adobe Commerce and Magento to the fixed version for your release line (for example 2.4.9-2026-aug, 2.4.8-2026-aug or 2.4.7-2026-aug).

Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-71362

item.title: Keep patched: Adobe Commerce and Magento: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine
item.description:
Adobe Commerce and Magento: RCE · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · fix: Hotfix for CVE-2026-7565

First step: Update Adobe Commerce and Magento to Hotfix for CVE-2026-7565 or later.

Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-75650
